name: ba-tax-overview
description: Tax overview for Bosnia and Herzegovina for tax year 2026: one page on how the system is split between the state (VAT, customs and excise, run by the Indirect Taxation Authority, UIO) and the Federation of BiH (FBiH), Republika Srpska (RS) and Brčko District (BD), which each set and collect their own profit tax, income tax and contributions. Covers the tax year; the KM 1.95583 euro peg; residence; profit tax at 10%; income tax on salary (FBiH 10%, RS 8%, BD 10%) and the monthly allowances; employee and employer contributions (FBiH 31% plus 5%, RS 31%); withholding tax on payments abroad; dividends to individuals; VAT at 17% with a KM 100,000 registration threshold and monthly returns; and the main deadlines. Trigger phrases: Bosnia tax system, BiH taxes overview, FBiH vs RS tax, Brčko tax, porezi u BiH. Out of scope: detail in the domain skills linked below.
